## Terms

### Engagement (engagement)

| Term | Meaning | Say it like |
|---|---|---|
| **retainer** | monthly prepayment for reserved capacity | "Maintenance runs on a monthly retainer." |
| **scope creep** | uncontrolled feature growth outside the agreement | "Let's lock the scope to avoid scope creep." |

### Pricing (pricing & payment)

| Term | What it means | Why it matters | Say it like |
|---|---|---|---|
| **fixed-price** / **fixed bid** | flat fee for a defined scope | Predictable for the client; your own risk is managed through a clear scope document. | "Small tasks are fixed-price." |
| **milestone payment** | payment tied to work checkpoints | Aligns incentives — the client only pays for accepted work. | "Payment is milestone-based: 30/40/30." |
